thread:
Lee: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's GPU surge. TL;DR: autoscale lag + quota throttles caused degradation. I sketched a remediation board and tentative owners below — please confirm or reassign.

Lee: Actions I proposed:
- autoscale scheduler tuning: reduce cooldown, add predictive scale, tune thresholds — owner: ? — ETA: 7d
- quota emergency backstop: small reserved pool per region + backstop rules — owner: ? — ETA: 14d
- headroom forecasting + alerting: daily projections + regression alert on peak variance — owner: ? — ETA: 3d
- canary + graceful-degrade policy for heavy routes — owner: ? — ETA: 14d

Lee: Postmortem link: <https://redwood.internal/postmortems/gpu-surge-21987|postmortem doc>. I added a checklist in the board.

Maria: I can take the scheduler tuning. Will open an RFC and an initial PR with conservative cooldown changes. Plan to run microbenchmarks on staging and report perf diff. ETA Thu EOD.

Raj: I'll own the quota backstop policy. Need expected spare capacity numbers though — @Olivia can finance confirm temporary reserve budget? Also will draft the policy and a small operator playbook.

Olivia: Finance OK to fund a temporary 10% reserve across NA/EU for up to 4 weeks while we stabilize. I'll send a formal note to billing and cc the SRE owners.

Anya: I'll take headroom forecasting and alerting. Will push a spreadsheet and a dashboard template to the remediation board. Quick Q: window for sampling — 24h or 72h?

Raj: 24h with a weighted peak multiplier is fine. Sharing the query we used last night to extract GPU utilization peaks:
```sql
SELECT region, node_pool, max(avg_gpu_util) as peak
FROM metrics.gpu_utilization
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY region, node_pool;
```
I'll add a variant with 72h for sensitivity.

Maria: For the tuning plan I'll start with these knobs: cooldown -> 30s (was 90s), scale_threshold -> 65% (was 80%), predictive window -> 30s. I'll run 3 runs on staging and paste the logs here.

deploy-bot: autoscale-tuning PR #482 merged to staging by Maria — CI: green.

Lee: Nice — thanks. Raj, once you draft the quota policy please add an emergency runbook step: how to quickly route heavy routes to dedicated pools.

Raj: Will do. Adding a step to rename route tags and an automated route-override play.

Olivia: Product note: we want a canary policy guard for premium customers to avoid impact. @Lee @Maria can we include route-level throttles as part of the canary plan?

Lee: Yes — canary policy will include route-level throttles + auto-fallback to lighter model variant. Maria to add to RFC.

Anya: Uploaded headroom forecast v1 to the board (tab: daily_projection). Initial call shows we need ~12% headroom in NA at peak. Will iterate.

Lee: Ownership summary (confirm): Maria -> scheduler tuning; Raj -> quota backstop + runbook; Anya -> headroom forecast + alerting; Olivia -> finance & product coordination for reserve + canary constraints. I'll schedule a 30-min sync Thu 10:30am and a recurring 30-min check until all items are closed.

Maria: Confirmed.

Raj: Confirmed.

Anya: Confirmed.

Olivia: Confirmed.

Lee: Thanks all — please add estimated PR/issue links to the board before EOD and mark blockers. We'll close this loop next week. :thumbsup:
